status: model: every expected value is computed by hs_game_sdk.mark1_automation_model from the inputs beside it; nothing here is measured yet. The interval's shape and the 0.25 s floor are static reading and measured (RDM 7.1, 7.5); the 1.0 s base cast time, the replenish unit 1.0, the 1500 maximum and the 30 baseline replenish are assumptions until Live 1 (cast-base, regen-units).
source: docs/models/mark1-automation-spec.md; hs-game-sdk/python/hs_game_sdk/mark1_automation_model.py; checked by tests/test_mark1_automation_model.py (hub) and by ForgePact's test_mark1_priority_behavior.py (interval, within 1 ms) and test_mark1_cost_behavior.py (drain, maxmana)

units.percent: % of maximum mana per second per automated skill
units.expected_drain: replenish units (mana per second at unit 1)
units.original: the game's own answer for the dispatcher id (42 for drain, 37 for maxmana)
units.cut_pct: % of maximum mana per automated skill
